results.title: Sharksquatch
results.overview: A half-shark, half-Sasquatch monster terrorizes Los Angeles.

results.title: Her Only Way Out
results.overview: After surviving a terrifying crash and being coerced into silence, a woman realizes the only way to escape is to stage her own death and disappear completely.

results.title: Jet Lag: The Game – Japanorama Finale
results.original_title: Jet Lag: The Game – Japanorama Finale
results.overview: Watch the conclusion of Jet Lag: The Game's biggest season ever with this screening of the final two, action-packed episodes as Tom & Adam race Sam & Ben to the top of Hokkaido.

results.title: Bittersuite
results.overview: During a wedding at a hotel, Bety, a young receptionist, becomes intrigued by Vicki, a mysterious older guest. The night lures them to the pool, the tension builds, and everything ends with an unexpected disappearance.

results.title: The Shadow
results.overview: A haunted house security guard encounters a spooky shadow.

results.title: Omnipresentes
results.overview: In an abandoned city after a zombie epidemic, José walks the streets looking for supplies in houses, stores and taps to survive. He lives with the freedom that he did not have before the infectious outbreak. At the same time, Matías and Andrea arrive in the same city and are gathering supplies to meet his mother again and go to a safe area. Then they meet.

results.title: François.e
results.overview: A struggling screenwriter falsely claims to be transgender to get funding.

results.title: Awake
results.overview: A corrupt police officer investigates his best friend's murder, getting involved in an underground drug ring in Southern Rhode Island.

results.title: Simon Says
results.overview: A group of friends gathers for a party when a mysterious entertainer named Simon arrives to host a game of Simon Says. What begins as a harmless game becomes a deadly fight for survival, where one wrong move can cost them their lives.

results.title: Milyonluk Hurdacı
results.overview: To win back the family he lost through a lifetime of infidelity, an aging scrap dealer leads his estranged children on a bizarre quest to sell a sacred relic left by a dead friend. Along the way—from weddings to funerals—they find something far more precious than money.

results.title: Tribeca 25
results.overview: 25 years after 9/11, discover how Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal transformed an ambitious effort to revive Lower Manhattan into one of the world's leading cultural institutions. Through rare archival footage, exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access, explore how art can foster community, confront injustice, and help shape culture.

results.title: The Squirrel
results.overview: Pasi, a lonely but kind-hearted designer of artificial animals, lives in a world where nature is just a memory and human well-being is organized with perhaps too much care. One day, Pasi accidentally finds the world's last living squirrel and meets Emilia, an official who enforces the rules of well-being. Pasi decides to defy society's rules and help the squirrel, but something unexpected happens—the squirrel becomes depressed and Pasi falls in love.

results.title: CFNY: The Spirit of Radio
results.overview: In 1976, radio station CFNY 102.1FM went on the air, broadcast live from a modest suburban house just north of Toronto, and went on to become one of the most influential punk, new wave and alternative radio stations in the world. This is the story of their mission to bring the most exciting music in the world to the masses. It's also a story of the personalities, lawsuits, bankruptcies, concerts, and listener protests that went along with it.

results.title: The Shrew of Destiny
results.overview: Shrews are small, lovely and always hungry mammals… which Happen to have some epic adventures! When dark shadow is cast upon the Valley of Shrews an old prophecy is remembered: the Great Enemy, destroyer of all life in the forest will bring doom to all shrews. But there is also an optimistic part of the legend – the shrew of destiny will come to aid its tribe in the darkest hour. But what if the chosen one turns out to be the smallest, weakest and honestly not-so-bright shrew?

results.title: Ring Around
results.overview: George races through a hilarious checklist of phone calls, but the humour collapses when his last conversation reveals the news he’s terrified to share.

results.title: The Silo and Us
results.overview: In a tiny Danish town, an abandoned grain silo is to become an artistic landmark with an observation tower and international art center, aiming to revitalize the town which is caught in a downward spiral of depopulation and store closures. But not everyone shares the enthusiasm. "The Silo and Us" a warm portrait of the urbane and the provincial, of highbrow and low key, of horn-rimmed glasses and flannel shirts. And everything in between.

results.title: Burned Edges
results.overview: Burned Edges is a culinary drama about ambition pushed too far.  Inside the relentless heat of a pizza kitchen, a driven chef sacrifices sleep, love, and loyalty in pursuit of greatness slowly burning the very relationships that once grounded him.  It’s a story about overwork, obsession, and the cost of chasing a dream without knowing when to stop.

results.title: My Amazing Grandma
results.overview: Toñi, an eccentric grandmother, gets by between failed businesses and a carefree attitude. Her daughter Daniela, a stressed executive and single mom, wants to keep her away.

results.title: Come with Me
results.overview: Working-class Simon Ward's life unravels after a traumatic home invasion, mounting problems at work and the loss of his best friend. Falling under the influence of rhetoric-spewing radio host Dalton Kirby, Simon spirals into a violent attempt to correct the injustice he believes surrounds him.
